newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian policmen shoot each other dead by mistake.
newsitem.headline: Russian policmen shoot each other dead by mistake.

text.p: Two Russian policemen shot each other dead in a case of mistaken identity while trying to apprehend suspected robbers, a police official said on Monday.
The incident took place in Nizhny Novgorod east of Moscow on Friday when one group of policemen took another group for the crooks after they refused an order to put down their weapons.
"It was dark and they could not see each other very well," the official said. The two men were buried on Monday.
